title: Replication materials for: Calibrating Synthetic Respondents — A Within-Persona Experiment on Public Reactions to Protest in Turkey
description: Code, prompts, configuration, aggregated results, and figures for the paper. Persona corpora and raw model completions are archived separately in the Zenodo record and, in the case of TGSS 2024 microdata, obtained from Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18721350 (not redistributed here).
